title: What is GEO and why your business should care
metaTitle: What is GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)? | Viesigners
description: GEO makes your content citable by ChatGPT, Gemini and Perplexity. Definition, how it differs from SEO, and seven concrete steps to apply.
summary: **GEO (Generative Engine Optimization)** aims to have AI like ChatGPT, Gemini or Perplexity understand, trust and cite your content.
It doesn't replace SEO: it builds on it and adds specific practices (direct answers, structured data, a clear entity).
The basic steps are simple and within reach of most sites.

body.p: GEO is the set of practices that make your content easy to understand, verify and cite for AI-based answer engines. Where SEO tries to place you in a list of links, GEO tries to get you to appear **in the answer itself**.

More and more people ask their questions directly to an AI assistant rather than browse ten links. These assistants synthesize an answer and cite a small number of sources. If your site isn't among them, your competitors take the spot.

body.h2: SEO and GEO: what changes, what stays

ul: **What stays:** a fast, well-structured site with useful content and demonstrated expertise.
**What's added:** direct answers at the top of pages, question-and-answer sections, structured data and a clear company identity on the web.
**What changes in measurement:** besides rankings and clicks, you track citations and mentions in AI answers.
Answer a specific question in the first two sentences of a page.
Add an FAQ to every important page, with short, verifiable answers.
Clearly identify the company and authors (names, roles, consistent contact details).
Add schema.org structured data (organization, service, FAQ, article).
Allow AI crawlers in robots.txt and provide an llms.txt file.
Cite sources and dated figures rather than vague claims.
Keep the site fast, readable on mobile and up to date.

body.p: No technique guarantees an AI citation. These practices increase your chances and also improve your visitors' experience, which is already a good return on investment. To learn about our support, see our [SEO/GEO](@seo-geo) service.

a: No. GEO builds on SEO foundations (structure, content, performance) and adds practices specific to AI answer engines.

faq.q: Can I measure my visibility in AI?
a: Yes, by regularly checking whether your business is cited for a set of key questions in the main assistants, and by tracking traffic coming from those sources.
